classes.name: TerminationReasonController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing termination reason-related data and interactions within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It initializes the termination reason service and prepares Vue components for rendering UI related to termination reasons.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonService
methods.description: Provides an instance of TerminationReasonConfigurationService, creating it if it does not already exist.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with termination reasons in use before rendering the view.
